verdict.rationale: mParticle publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 YAML spec for its Events API, suitable for SDK generation. The docs state this spec covers the Events API only, and the Platform and Profile API pages carry no spec, so much of the API surface has no machine-readable description. Missing for 10: OpenAPI specs for the Platform, Profile, and other APIs (Warehouse Sync, DSR), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API: Events API Open API Spec.
The spec file itself downloads as OpenAPI 3.0.3 YAML
